observations: Black game console with a split design, characteristic of the PS4 Fat model.
The 'PS4' logo is visible on the right side of the console in photo 0.
Two controllers are shown: one standard black DualShock 4 and one custom-colored controller with a paint-splatter design.
A UK-style 3-pin power plug is visible in all photos.
The console surface shows some light dust and minor scuffs.
A small piece of paper is tucked between the controllers in photos 0 and 1.

claims.evidence: No storage label or model number is visible in the photos.
Requires a video of the console booting to a homebrew menu.
No video of the console powered on or connected to a screen is provided.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be smaller than 500GB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate the menu.

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on and connected to a TV.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the hard drive capacity.
Video of the console connected to the internet and logged into PSN.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate the menu.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
